data.title: Make sure to only copy data that the model has actually returned
data.author: tmadlener
data.body:
BEGINRELEASENOTES
- Make sure to only copy data to the `output` that the model actually returns when running inference

ENDRELEASENOTES

- [x] Includes #17 

Previously we unconditionally memcpy-d as many elements as we could fit
into output. However, output is in some cases a maximum number of
elements not an exact number of elements that the model will return from
inference. Hence, we read garbage data past the actual data returned
from the inference. It has been without consequence so far because we
haven't touched that data later until now and apparently we had large
enough memory pages to not trigger a seg fault.

The python sources of k4FWCore are installed to a hardcoded `python/k4FWCore`, but the `k4FWCorePluginsConf.py` generated by Gaudi is installed to `${GAUDI_INSTALL_PYTHONDIR}/k4FWCore`. Up to now both were the same directory because Gaudi defaulted `GAUDI_INSTALL_PYTHONDIR` to `python`.

data.title: Fix boolean properties on the k4run command line
data.author: madbaron
data.body:
Boolean properties could not be switched off from the command line:
- when the property is set in the options file, argparse is given type=bool, and bool("False") is True
- when the property is left at its default, its value is propertyNoValue (a string), so the argument is parsed as a string and Gaudi later converts it with bool("False"), which is again True

Parse boolean properties (detected from the value or, if unset, from the default) with a dedicated parser that accepts True/False, true/false and 1/0 and rejects anything else. A bare flag (e.g. "--MetadataSvc.SkipIfSameValue") now means True instead of setting None, which Gaudi converted to False.

Add tests for switching off a property set in the options file, one left at its default, a bare flag and an invalid value.

BEGI…

data.title: Use upstream ACTS converters
data.author: madbaron
data.body:
BEGINRELEASENOTES
- Use the centralised ACTS EDM4hep converter (`ActsPlugins::EDM4hepUtil`) instead of the local conversion code. `ACTS2edm4hep_track` is now a thin wrapper around `writeTrack`, and the seed (`AtFirstHit`) and calorimeter (`AtCalorimeter`) track states are built with `writeTrackState`.
- Remove `ACTS2edm4hep_trackState`, whose LCIO parameter conversion and covariance packing are now provided by the ACTS plugin.
- Fix the track state covariance layout: it now follows the EDM4hep parameter order (`edm4hep::TrackParams`), so downstream consumers read the correct elements.
- Link against `Acts::PluginEDM4hep`.

ENDRELEASENOTES
